# Deltempo

> Deltempo is a fast, portable, open-source Windows cleaner and NT memory optimizer for Windows 10 and 11. Zero telemetry, 100% local, MIT licensed.

- [Official Website](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/): Primary homepage and downloads
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/Beso1227/Deltempo): Source code, issues, and community contributions
- [Download](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/download/): Standalone executable and WinGet installation
- [Documentation](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/docs/): Technical guide to 25+ scopes, safety tiers, and CLI commands
- [FAQ](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/faq/): Common questions on safety, GPU caches, and NT memory
- [Changelog](https://beso1227.github.io/Deltempo/changelog/): Release notes and version history

## Overview
Deltempo purges disposable system, developer, and browser caches, recovers disk space, and trims inactive Windows memory working sets with zero telemetry.
Package identifier for Microsoft WinGet: `winget install Beso1227.Deltempo`
